details.description: Code Llama - Python 34B is Meta's Python-specialized version of the 34B Code Llama base model, given additional fine-tuning on 100 billion tokens of largely Python source code on top of the shared 500-billion-token code training set. Meta released it August 24, 2023 alongside the base and Instruct 34B checkpoints, aimed at Python-specific code generation and completion rather than general instruction-following.
advantages: Scores 53.7% pass@1 on HumanEval and 56.2% pass@1 on MBPP (Code Llama paper, Table 2), the highest HumanEval score among the three 34B Code Llama variants.
Fine-tuned on an additional 100 billion tokens of Python-heavy data on top of the base model's training set (Meta Code Llama blog).
disadvantages: Specialized for Python rather than general instruction-following; Meta's Hugging Face model card positions the separate Instruct variant as the safer choice for code-assistant and chat-style deployments.
Unlike the 7B and 13B Code Llama sizes, the 34B and 70B models were not trained with fill-in-the-middle (infilling) capability (Meta Code Llama blog).

notes: Meta's own blog sentence 'Code Llama 34B scored 53.7% on HumanEval and 56.2% on MBPP' actually matches this Python variant's row in the paper's Table 2, not the base 34B model's (48.8%/55.0%); the paper's per-variant table was used instead of the ambiguous blog sentence. Catalog's 16384 max_input/max_output_tokens matches Fireworks' listed ~16.3k-token serving context.
